items.title: Ingredients for robotics research
items.summary: We’re releasing eight simulated robotics environments and a Baselines implementation of Hindsight Experience Replay, all developed for our research over the past year. We’ve used these environments to train models which work on physical robots. We’re also releasing a set of requests for robotics research.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了八个模拟机器人环境，并开源了Hindsight Experience Replay（HER）的Baselines实现。这些工具旨在支持机器人研究，通过仿真环境训练模型，并验证其在物理机器人上的迁移效果。此次发布还包含了一系列机器人研究需求，旨在推动该领域的标准化与技术进步。
